summary: This joint resolution nullifies the EPA rule published April 6, 2023, that grants California a preemption waiver for its heavy-duty vehicle emission standards, warranty rules, and zero-emission requirements.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly nullifies an EPA notice that granted California a waiver to implement stricter heavy-duty vehicle emission standards. By doing so, it removes a measure aimed at reducing emissions, which is a core aspect of environmental protection.
